added_failures_note: the reviewed run records no baseline_suite and no after_suite gate; its manifest's test_logs names one head gate, gate_head.log (129 passed, 8 skipped, 0 failed, EXIT=0), which reports zero failing tests, so there is no pre-change arm to subtract and added_failure_count is 0 with no added ids.

findings.text: follow-on: the fused mass is returned as the scores map and rendered by format_signals_report (imas_codex/llm/search_formatters.py:121) as "(score: {:.2f})", so the per-signal number shown to the user is now the reciprocal-rank mass (about 1/61 = 0.02) rather than a cosine or BM25 magnitude; nearly every match displays as 0.02, so the displayed score no longer conveys similarity, a user-facing change the plan did not call out.

follow-on: "assert scores[\"tcv:magnetics/cc\"] == pytest.approx(scores[\"tcv:magnetics/ip\"])" compares two outputs of the code under test to each other rather than to an independent value (it replaced the concrete "== approx(13.0)"), so it holds for any implementation that keeps a text rank-1 and a vector rank-1 at equal mass; the load-bearing guard in that test is the id order asserted on :224.

follow-on: _text_search_signals requests k*2 rows, so SIGNAL_TEXT_POOL=50 yields a 100-candidate full-text stream; the done_when's "50-candidate full-text pool" and the constant name understate the stream the fusion actually consumes (the vector pool is 100 as claimed, search_tools.py:75).

follow-on: _additive_rank re-implements the retired blend score*0.7 + text*0.3 + 0.1 as a test-local frozen oracle; it forks no live production owner (that rule was removed from search_tools.py), but it is a textual copy the promotion clone detector may flag, matching the same-pattern note raised on the sibling review of ssfms-pooled-labels.
